messages.subject: Management of buttons
parts:
Hi,

First of all I would like to thank the shiny team, shiny is a great tool. Nevertheless I have questions about the management of buttons. I use the actionButton (from shiny incubator) to create some buttons (the number of these buttons varies depending of other things). But I have no idea how to know which button has been clicked since the value associated to the button’s id in the input variable only return the number of time the button has been clicked?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Management of buttons
parts:
Each action button should have a unique inputId. If each button has a unique effect, then you should set up a separate observer for each button. Does that make sense?

observe({
  if (input$button1 == 0) return()
  isolate({
    # React to button 1 being pressed
  })
})

observe({
  if (input$button2 == 0) return()
  isolate({
    # React to button 2 being pressed
  })
})
